intent: 能源项目线封面：以成熟、可实现的学生工程原型替代糖果色、圆润简单的玩具造型。
direction: 所有自制结构件使用 FDM 3D 打印，普通电机、电子模块与螺丝可采购。
工程感来自功能明确的薄壁、加强筋、接合、调节、布线、测量和测试场景；不靠无关复杂设备。
保留自然暖光与多样场景，避免每张图复制同一工作台。
封面为生成的设计意向图，不是经过制造验证的成品照片，也不充当接线图或零件规格。
原始封面保留，新资源使用版本文件名，避免缓存旧图。

entries.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset: landscape 3:2 editorial course cover, no text. A mature, ambitious student-built renewable energy engineering prototype, sophisticated functional construction NOT a children's science toy.
A compact tabletop solar/wind/supercapacitor micro-energy test station, at three-quarter low eye level, assembled from finely FDM-printed charcoal and warm light-gray polymer parts with subtle visible layers. Palm-sized base about 160 mm across, a 45 mm photovoltaic cell in a thin articulated two-axis cradle, a roughly 110 mm three-blade wind rotor on a ribbed hollow printed tower with a fine full protective lattice cage, small purchased DC generator behind rotor. Lower base has detachable printed electronics trays, one exposed small energy-harvesting PCB with a SINGLE small cylindrical supercapacitor, screw terminal connectors, a manual source-selector switch, very small status LED. Neat red/black wires visibly route through printed cable clips, connectable plugs and strain relief. Few simple steel M3 screws and the small motor are the only metal construction parts.
Show credible designed features: gussets, mounting slots, split motor clamp, replaceable pitch-adjustment hub, precision mating joints, thin geometric ribs, accessible test points; enough engineering density to invite inspection while readable at thumbnail scale. It must look attainable with desktop FDM printing and simple off-the-shelf electronics, not injection-moulded or machined industrial equipment.
Scene: student engineering exhibition/test bench with dark neutral work surface, softly blurred warm architectural daylight behind; no child, no computer operator. Restrained warm daylight grazes printed textures, deep real shadows, photographic lens and tactile physical materials, handsome technical magazine photography. Tight composition with whole apparatus inside the central 80% safe area and subject occupying most of the frame. Clear strong silhouette, not sprawling props. Charcoal structure, off-white structural accents, one small muted orange functional adjustment detail; NO candy colors, toy rounded blocks, Lego appearance, cartoon styling, sci-fi holograms, huge batteries, exposed industrial machinery, metal frame, dramatic fake energy beams, readable lettering or logos. This is a realistic design illustration, not a claim of a built tested kit.
entries.refinement: Refine this energy engineering cover. Preserve the mature, realistic FDM-printed modular prototype, fine ribs, purposeful details, gray palette with the single orange adjustment knob, natural warm lighting and the basic arrangement. TWO precise corrections: (1) pull the camera back so the ENTIRE wind rotor and whole station fit within the frame with at least 10 percent margin on all sides, no blade clipped; (2) the rotor must be fully enclosed INSIDE its protective cage, with a fine dark PRINTED mesh grill visibly in FRONT of the three blades as well as behind and around the perimeter. The blades must not be sitting outside or in front of the safety cage. Show actual thin printable dark-polymer grill ribs, not metal wire or an open ring. Keep rotor visible through the grill. Don't change other components. No extra props, text, logos. Landscape 3:2.
